build_scope: UI source commit with frozen bootstrap/build tools from d23f232; current-main network policy excluded from this binary and acceptance.
contracts: Footer workspace dots use Rust-owned horizontal viewport geometry, authoritative fractional X offset, extent/reveal/clamp and scrollbar allocation. The existing custom Rust-backed horizontal scrollbar remains injected. Native footer ScrollView subscriptions/synchronization and Rust-footer-layout ScrollView cast are removed.

PanelViewport selects a single primary axis. Native baseline retains original horizontal ScrollView policy; other clients keep vertical defaults. Rust decides horizontal geometry and overflow-edge rectangles; platform adapters apply transforms, input, scrollbar updates, AX X/Y metadata and actions for that axis.

The horizontal native oracle compares content/viewport extent, offsets, clamps, minimum and oversized-target reveal against real ScrollView at multiple sizes. The actual shared footer case checks ownership and sidebar resize, derives native range from live content/viewport geometry, and verifies positive-range reveal/Home/End/AX scroll-right; Metal must retain overflowing full dot widths at both sizes. Both verify final content shrink after removing 10 workspaces.

A dedicated isolated-widget case sends actual raw horizontal fractional and momentum events through Widget, checks exact accumulated pixels, vertical event propagation, velocity rejection, both clamps and collapse. Existing real-footer mouse thumb drag/emoji projection/click-selection/settings/pin/fallback contracts remain.

The full source includes the preceding main-sidebar and palette viewport migrations, shared raw-trackpad and capture cancellation corrections. Other vertical viewport clients retain their existing contracts in the full matrix.

No dependency, browser service/store/admission/persistence policy changed. Native View/node/control identity, measurement, global gesture arbitration, input/focus/AX/window/frame/bar and animation adapters remain.
limits: Full automated acceptance does not establish complete functional/manual/release parity.
Remaining native control/node/container/menu/input/window ownership still needs migration.
Global workspace swipe arbitration remains native shell policy. The horizontal raw-event case uses a separate Widget; physical hardware trackpad behavior remains manual acceptance.
Manual IME candidate windows, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
No controlled CPU/GPU/drawable-presentation/input-latency or memory gain established.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside the frozen UI lab checkpoint.

initial_probe.note: Metal passed all six cases. Views passed two but the real-footer fixture incorrectly required overflow: the original native footer retains use_contents_preferred_size=false and may fit its contents (observed range zero in this probe); Metal has always used full preferred width and overflow. Final shared fixture derives native extent from live geometry and validates scrolling when it overflows; Metal must overflow at both sizes and retain keys/AX/reveal. The independent native oracle still compares equal preferred-size configurations; no production policy was changed for this test correction.

second_probe.note: Metal passed all six. The revised Views fixture incorrectly assumed native fit always means zero range. Native can retain prior content width through resize (observed width 174, viewport 134, maximum 40). Final oracle derives native range from live geometry, checks no-offset/no-bar when fitted and exercises scrolling when overflowing; Metal must overflow at both widths. No production behavior changed for this correction.

gpu_log_diagnostics.scope: Diagnostics remain in retained logs; launcher/case success does not diagnose or resolve them.
